The '''T-class long-range personal cruiser''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] near the end of the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The T-class was considered one of the most advanced ships in the [[Sith fleet (New Sith Wars)|Sith fleet]]. As with most starships, it was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]] for [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] travel. The controls were of a standard, easy-to-use type, and there was also an autopilot. Additionally, at least some T-class vessels had [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]], although these did not seem to have had an interstellar range. They could launch [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable [[message drone]]s, although these may not have been carried as standard.<ref name="PoD" />

==History==
One T-class personal [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was the ''[[Valcyn/Legends|Valcyn]]'', presented by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan|Kaan]] to [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qordis]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] for his work with the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]], but it was stolen by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane]] when he left [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="PoD" />
